name: PCEBench
description: PCEBench is a multi-dimensional benchmark for evaluating large language models on parallel code generation tasks. It assesses not only correctness but also efficiency, scalability, and data race detection, using scripts compatible with compilers and data race checkers.
reputation: A very recent, niche benchmark introduced for parallel code generation research, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on parallel code generation challenges including compilability, executability, correctness, and speedup over serial implementations.
